services.name: Studio Rental
services.desc: Our rentals are available in both the ceramics studio and metals studio by the hour and cost per person $15/hour for members and $20/hour for non-members. Every person in the room for the rental must register. It is a requirement that renters have previously taken a class at Sweetwater in their chosen studio within the last year. Ceramic studio renters may purchase clay in increments of 25 lb. blocks for $35 members/ $45 non-members (includes glazing & firing fee). services.name: Exhibition Art
services.desc: During Naptime is a collection of paintings created during my youngest daughter’s first year of life, mostly while she napped in her crib and a baby monitor crackled in the background of my studio. Made in the fragmented scraps of free time that motherhood allows, these paintings became a way to carve out much-needed space for my own creativity, grief, healing, and joy. My older daughter often joined me in the studio, making art of her own, helping choose an even brighter color, and providing unsolicited critique along the way 🙂 Together, those small moments accumulated into something larger than I imagined: a body of work that allows my inner child to sing out alongside my daughters’,

services.name: Private Lessons
services.desc: Sweetwater offers private lessons for drawing, painting, ceramics, metalsmithing, and more! Perhaps you want to work on developing a portfolio for school, job applications, or exhibitions. You will be matched to the perfect instructor to help you develop your existing skills or begin to learn a brand new art form. Private lessons start at $70/hour for drawing and painting, and $85/hour for ceramics. Lessons are sold in packs of a minimum of four lessons. Please send a detailed inquiry to sbaxter@sweetwaterartcenter.org outlining your experience level, the type of lessons you are interested in, and your availability. services.desc: Sweetwater Art Center is the perfect venue to host an impactful artistic experience for your corporate and team-building events! Choose from one of our amazing packages to get your creative juices flowing and bring your team together in a unique, hands-on activity. You will be matched with one of our amazing Sweetwater teaching artists to host your event, and all corporate packages are BYOB! Please fill out an inquiry for one of our packages to get started. blurb: Sweetwater Center for the Arts was established in 1975 as a nonprofit organization that sought to enrich its community by providing consistent and high-quality arts education for all ages. Almost 50 years later, Sweetwater offers nearly 400 classes, workshops, and lectures annually.
